facts.fact: The Internet Society Pulse IXP Tracker, drawing on PeeringDB self-reported data, lists the Angola Internet Exchange Point (angonix) in Luanda as active with 23 members, at one physical location, as of June 2026; Pulse says 86% of Angola's 63 active networks are members or customers of members of an IXP.

The Internet Society Pulse IXP Tracker, drawing on PeeringDB self-reported data, lists a second exchange, Angola IXP, in Luanda as active with 14 members at three physical locations, as of June 2026; the page counts 2 active IXPs with a combined 29 members.

facts.fact: Portal de TI reports analyst Darwin Costa said Angonix and Angola IXP, Angola's two main exchange points, peaked at 59.5 Gbps and above 11 Gbps in late July 2025, with Microsoft and Meta present at these IXPs.

note: Cities of the two IXPs and two traffic dates a year apart are not given.

facts.fact: The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Angola: Angola-IXP (ANG-IXP), Luanda, and Angonix, Luanda.
Analyst Darwin Costa, interviewed by Portal de T.I., says Angola's active internet exchange points, Angonix and Angola-IXP, are both in Luanda.

note: Regional exchanges are only proposed; no content network or traffic figure is stated.

facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse says Angola recorded gains in reported IXP memberships and domestic network coverage between March 2019 and March 2026 without a rise in its reported IXP count, which shows networks as members of a reported exchange.
